messages.content: 你能先幫我找一個素食，主菜的食譜嗎？並且能在30分鐘內準備好嗎？之後，能否請你找出重力的科學發現的詳細資料，使用預設的方法？完成後，我也想知道使用同樣方法發現希格斯玻色子的相關資料。最後，能否幫我找一個能在45分鐘內準備的無麩質甜點食譜？

function.name: find_recipe
function.description: Find a recipe based on the dietary restrictions, recipe type, and time constraints. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

dietary_restrictions.description: Dietary restrictions e.g. vegan, vegetarian, gluten free, dairy free.

recipe_type.description: Type of the recipe. E.g. dessert, main course, breakfast.

time.description: Time limit in minutes to prep the meal.

function.name: science_history_get_discovery_details
function.description: Retrieve the details of a scientific discovery based on the discovery name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

discovery.description: The name of the discovery, e.g. Gravity

method_used.description: The method used for the discovery, default value is 'default' which gives the most accepted method.

message.reasoning:
We need to call two functions sequentially? Actually we have three tasks:

1) Find a recipe with dietary restriction "vegan", recipe_type "main course" within 30 min.

2) Get discovery details for gravity using default method (no argument needed).

3) Also get discovery details for Higgs boson using same method.

But note the second function expects only one parameter; but we can call it twice separately or maybe combine? We might just call once per request. But user wants both discoveries after retrieving gravity's details. So we should do separate calls.

Then third task: find a recipe with no gluten ("gluten-free") sweet dish within 45 min.

Thus total four function calls: first find_recipe, then science_history_get_discovery_details for gravity, again for higgs boson, finally another find_recipe for gluten-free dessert.

We'll produce JSON responses accordingly.

Let's craft calls.

First call: find_recipe(dietary_restrictions="vegan", recipe_type="main course", time=30)

Second call: science_history_get_discovery_details(discovery="Gravity")

Third call: science_history_get_discovery_details(discovery="Higgs Boson")

Fourth call: find_recipe(dietary_restrictions="gluten free", recipe_type="dessert", time=45)

Return results as array of objects each containing result from respective function.

Ok let's output.
